content: How much protein should I eat to build muscle?

Aim for about 1.6–2.2 g of protein per kg of bodyweight per day. Going above that won't hurt, but it adds little. Spread it over 3–5 meals with roughly 20–40 g each, and keep total calories at maintenance or a slight surplus. 💪

If you tell me your bodyweight, I'll work out your daily number.
